name: Vue 3 Mastery
shortDescription: Learn Vue 3 from scratch with hands-on projects.
longDescription: This course covers the fundamentals of Vue 3, including composition API, reactive state management, and component-based architecture. Build real-world projects and become proficient in developing modern web interfaces with Vue.

reviews.author: Alice
reviews.comment: Excellent course, very thorough and clear.

reviews.author: Bob
reviews.comment: Great content, but could use more examples.

name: Advanced TypeScript
shortDescription: Deep dive into TypeScript advanced features.
longDescription: Take your TypeScript skills to the next level by exploring advanced language features, design patterns, and real-world application development techniques. This course is ideal for developers who are comfortable with TypeScript basics and want to leverage its full power in large-scale projects.

reviews.author: Charlie
reviews.comment: A must-have for serious TypeScript developers.

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.comment: Very informative, though some sections were a bit fast.

name: UI Design for Developers
shortDescription: Learn the fundamentals of user interface design.
longDescription: Designed for developers without a design background, this course teaches the principles of effective UI/UX design. Covering typography, color theory, layout, and interactive prototyping, you'll learn to create visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces for your applications.

reviews.author: Eve
reviews.comment: Good overview of UI basics with practical tips.
